data.name: Omkar Dnyanmote
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Omkar Dnyanmote has made a big mark in cricket. With 9 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 23*, with an average of 21.00 and a quick strike rate of 120.69. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 7 sixes and 5 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 3.0 overs, taking 1 wickets at an economy rate of 8.33. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
